name: waynestate/advisor
description: Wayne State's own MCP server: orients a developer and gives their coding agent read-only tools into every project of the app stack.

suggest.laravel/mcp: For the Laravel adapter (1.1.2): ADVISOR then runs beside Laravel Boost with `php artisan mcp:start advisor`

content:drift: @php -r "if(trim((string)getenv('ADVISOR_STACK_DIR'))===''){echo 'ADVISOR_STACK_DIR=<folder holding the stack repos> composer content:drift'.PHP_EOL;exit(1);}"

scripts-descriptions.ci: Run every CI check: manifest, bundled content, tests, style, agent-ready files, the docs site, static analysis, audit
scripts-descriptions.docs: Build the docs site into site/docs/ from docs/ (Squire's shared builder).
scripts-descriptions.docs:check: Fail when site/docs/ is stale or a docs page has a broken link, block or nav entry.
scripts-descriptions.content:drift: Fail when data/ no longer matches the stack repos in ADVISOR_STACK_DIR; without the variable it prints how to run it and exits 1.
scripts-descriptions.site:agent-ready: Rewrite the Markdown twins, llms.txt, llms-full.txt, robots.txt and sitemap.xml in site/ (Squire's agent-ready kit).
scripts-descriptions.site:agent-ready-check: Fail when the agent-ready files are stale, a page lacks its Markdown link, a prompt drifts from the docs, or the kit was edited here.
